issues.description: The current screen is the Auth/Sign-in page instead of the expected Step-2 room type selection page. The URL shows /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-2, meaning the user is being redirected to auth before reaching step-2. The expected behavior is: 6 room type buttons (Living Room, Bedroom, Dining Room, Home Office, Kitchen, Bathroom), followed by a 2x2 grid of style images for anchor question 1 of 3, with progress indicator and gold accent styling.
issues.element: Entire page content — showing auth form instead of room type selection UI
issues.root_cause: The /design/step-2 route has a middleware or page-level auth guard that redirects unauthenticated users to /auth?next=/design/step-2. Either the test session is not authenticated, or the middleware at apps/web/middleware.ts is protecting the /design/step-2 route and redirecting before the page can render. The page itself (apps/web/app/design/step-2/page.tsx) is not being reached.
